company.fit_rationale: A Bern-canton family firm that actively looks for healthier snacks for its machines and penalises sugar in its own label. Diablo bars and sweets would score well, but it is a vending operator rather than a classic distributor, so volumes depend on its machine estate.

company.name: The Asia Company S.A.
company.distributes: Asian and European foods: fresh produce, dry goods including snacks, drinks, frozen goods including desserts, and non-food.
company.channels_supplied: Swiss restaurants and retailers, delivered in refrigerated vehicles.
what_they_do_well: Founded in 2010 in Muenchenstein to import Asian and European foods for Swiss restaurants and retailers.
ISO 22000 certified since 2021, delivering with its own refrigerated vehicles.
company.fit_rationale: A Basel-area importer and wholesaler 6 km from the city centre with its own trade customer base among Asian restaurants and shops. Snacks are a listed category, but European sugar free sweets would be a new line for it.

company.name: Vermo AG
company.distributes: Ice cream, frozen, dairy, convenience, dry goods and vegan and vegetarian ranges.
company.channels_supplied: Not confirmed; profile suggests foodservice. Basel coverage not confirmed.
company.fit_rationale: A long-established independent foodservice supplier with a dry goods range. Directory data only and based in central Switzerland.
